details: (Geneea ji-NEE-ə) is a software company based in Prague, Czech Republic, specializing in NLP and AI solutions for news media. The company was founded in 2014 by Jiří Hana and Petr Hamerník with the aim of applying computational linguistics to commercial software. In 2019, the company formalised a cooperation agreement with Charles University.
